summary: The pending migration 20260921000002 creates one new, purely additive child table (maia_epistemic_join_integration_shadow_runs) that FK-references the existing maia_relational_field_shadow_runs(turn_id, model_name, architecture_version) UNIQUE constraint with ON DELETE CASCADE. It does not alter, rename, or drop any column, table, or constraint the old reader touches. The old reader's runner.ts/evidenceStore.ts write only to maia_relational_field_shadow_runs via an unchanged INSERT...ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING statement and never reference the new table or module; they remain fully functional and unaffected after this migration commits, before or without a target swap. Target code (epistemicTelemetryStore.ts) writes exactly the columns the migration defines, uses the identical ON CONFLICT key as the FK-unique triple, is only invoked after the parent evidence row has been persisted (guaranteeing FK satisfaction), and is gated behind an env flag so it is schema-independent when I4 is OFF, matching the migration's own comment. The JSONB CHECK vocabularies for admitted_standing_counts (7 keys) and refusal_code_counts (27 keys) are an exact match against the closed RelationStanding/RefusalCode unions in lib/ain/epistemic-join/types.ts, so there is no drift risk between the constitutional vocabulary and the stored telemetry shape. representation_closed is forced CHECK(=TRUE), which is consistent with evaluateJoin's structurally-typed always-false/'closed' return contract exercised in relationalField.ts. Since this is a single-file pending set wrapped in its own BEGIN/COMMIT, the only reachable prefixes are "nothing committed" (migration failed, rolled back) or "fully committed" (migration succeeded) — both leave the old reader's schema surface untouched. No high or medium findings were identified.

findings.evidence: representation_closed BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK (representation_closed = TRUE) forces the column to always hold TRUE; this is consistent with the fact that evaluateJoin's JoinEvaluation type structurally fixes downstreamRepresentationAuthorized:false and representationAuthority:'closed' (lib/ain/epistemic-join/types.ts), which relationalField.ts's representationClosed &&= ... reduction depends on, but the column itself carries no discriminating information once written and the CHECK will reject any future evolution of the evaluator that legitimately needs to record a non-closed representation state.
findings.fix: Either drop the CHECK (=TRUE) constraint and document that the column is reserved for future use, or add a code comment in the migration explaining the always-true invariant is intentional and tied to the current I2 evaluator's closed-representation guarantee, so a future evaluator change is not silently blocked by an unexplained constraint violation.
